reports.title: GE Vernova reports strong third quarter 2026 financial performance, raises 2026 guidance,

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: GE Vernova is raising its 2026 financial guidance and now expects revenue of $46.5-$47.5 billion, up from $45.5-$46.5 billion,
adjusted EBITDA margin* of 13.5%-14.5%, up from 12%-14%, and free cash flow* of $16-$17 billion, up from $11.5-$12.5 billion.
